about: Difficulty presets (#35 b, owner Nov 14): Easy / Medium / Hard / Extreme, the player's pick, changeable any time, kept with the game (the story section, so a save remembers it). Easy is the old kind danger: knocked out = her care scene, nothing lost. Harder presets bring real game overs (load a save), stronger creatures and sharper traps, a small lift to how well a delve counts, and a lower chance that she saves you. 'Jun saves you' (owner): a chance instead of a game over that grows with the bond and her Support skill, lower on harder presets. Every number is a first guess, tuned in the delve lab. Read by js/core/difficulty.js; the delve gets the preset object in Run.start({ difficulty }). Jun is non-lethal to people on every preset (one story moment aside, which the story engine owns): that is a content rule, not a number here.

easy.name: Easy
easy.line: The cozy way, as delves have always been. If you go down, she takes care of you and nothing is lost.

medium.name: Medium
medium.line: The same creatures, real danger. If you go down she may still save you. If she can't, it's game over and you load a save.

hard.name: Hard
hard.line: Tougher creatures, sharper traps, and she can't always reach you in time.

extreme.name: Extreme
extreme.line: The city at its worst. Every fight counts, and her saving you is a rare mercy.
